chunks: And al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Nadr, from 'Asim ibn Humayd, from Abi Basir and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, that the two of them heard him say:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would perform ghusl with a sa' of water and perform wudu (ablution) with a mudd of water.

key_terms.بِصَاعٍ: with a sa', a measured quantity of water used here for ghusl
key_terms.بِمُدٍّ: with a mudd, a smaller measured quantity of water used here for wudu (ablution)
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.مَاءٍ: water, the purifying substance used for ritual purification
key_terms.يَغْتَسِلُ: would perform ghusl, meaning ritual bathing

ai.seo_question: How much water did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم use for ghusl and wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding the amount of water used for ghusl and wudu (ablution). It serves as evidence in discussions of ritual purity and moderation in water usage during acts of worship.
